decisions.reason: The power-input specification does not change the signal interface; the same message's independent signal-connector specification is already fully captured by a separate MODIFY.
The existing same-message MODIFY already includes the specified four-pin JST-PH power input and its complete pinout, so no addition or edit is required.
The sensor-board power connector type and pinout do not alter I2C pull-ups, series resistance, bus speed, or cable-length conditioning.
The source specifies connector power pins and does not assign or change any ESP32-S3 GPIO.
The sensor-board power connector specification does not affect the native USB D+ and D- programming interface.
The shared JST-PH terminology is incidental; the source concerns the sensor-board power input and does not change the separate battery connector.
The source power-interface change does not affect SPS30 mode selection; the same message's independent SEL-to-GND requirement is already captured by its INTRODUCE Event.
The sensor-board power input has no effect on the main-board panel reset connector or its EN-to-GND action.
Listing 5V and 3V3 on the sensor-board power connector does not change which rails are monitored or the monitoring topology.
The sensor-board power connector pinout does not change LED supply voltage, level shifting, or 5V-rail shutdown behavior.
The source concerns the sensor-board interboard power input and does not modify the separate PIR connector requirement.
The sensor-board power connector specification does not change any panel button, switch, GPIO, or off-board control connection.
